title: Congress.gov Notifications Congress.gov Enhancements for April of 2026
summary:
We are pleased to bring you the Congress.gov enhancements for April of 2026.

Enhancement – House Roll Call Votes – 117th Congress

  • House roll call votes from the 117th Congress (2021-2022) are available to browse and search.
  • Use the House Roll Call Votes link in the Congressional Activity section of the Browse page to view a sortable list.
  • Learn more at About House Votes.

Enhancement – House Committee Prints – Browse

  • The committee is listed in the first column of the House committee prints browse page.
  • Select the title of a committee print to link to the full text.
